name_zh: 伊泰普/水电/瓜拉尼含水层：水资源联邦主义与跨国能源共治
name_en: Itaipu/Hydro/Guaraní Aquifer: Water Federalism & Transnational Energy Co-Governance
description_zh: 伊泰普水电站 (伊泰普大坝) 巴拉圭/巴西共建/1984 运行/14000MW/世界第二/巴拉圭电力 90%+ 来自水电/出口巴西/瓜拉尼含水层(南美第二大/阿根廷/巴西/巴拉圭/乌拉圭共享)。核心治理模式：水资源联邦主义 — 巴拉圭/巴西双边条约/实体双边/收益分成/技术转让/环境补偿/瓜拉尼含水层跨国管理体系(2010 协议/四国委员会/监测/保护/可持续利用)。体现 M175 水资源联邦主义 — 以"双边水电共治+收益分成机制+含水层跨国管理+能源主权"四位一体，在跨国河流/共享含水层/不对称实力四重约束中实现水资源联邦治理。
description_en: Itaipu Hydroelectric (Itaipu Dam) Paraguay/Brazil joint/1984 operational/14000MW/world #2/Paraguay 90%+ electricity from hydro/exports to Brazil/Guaraní Aquifer (South America 2nd largest/Argentina/Brazil/Paraguay/Uruguay shared). Core governance model: water federalism — Paraguay-Brazil bilateral treaty/binational entity/revenue sharing/tech transfer/environmental compensation/Guaraní Aquifer transnational management system (2010 agreement/four-nation commission/monitoring/protection/sustainable use). Exemplifies M175 Water Federalism — quaternity of 'binational hydro co-governance + revenue sharing mechanism + aquifer transnational management + energy sovereignty' achieving water federal governance amid quadruple constraints of transboundary rivers/shared aquifer/asymmetric power.
reason_zh: 伊泰普非单纯大坝，而是"双边实体+收益分成+含水层共治"三位一体水联邦样本。巴拉圭以主权小国地位谈判获 50% 电力/出口收益/技术转让，瓜拉尼含水层四国共治先例。M175 区隔于 M152 安第斯互惠(垂直)、M168 资源诅咒(石油)、M175 水联邦主义(核心)，核心在于"双边实体即治理载体+收益分成即主权实现+含水层共治即区域公共品"的跨国水治理范式。
reason_en: Itaipu not mere dam but 'binational entity + revenue sharing + aquifer co-governance' trinity water federalism sample. Paraguay as small sovereign negotiated 50% power/export revenue/tech transfer, Guaraní Aquifer four-nation co-governance precedent. M175 distinct from M152 Andean Reciprocity (vertical), M168 Resource Curse (oil), M175 Water Federalism (core), core: 'binational entity as governance vehicle + revenue sharing as sovereignty realization + aquifer co-governance as regional public good' transnational water governance paradigm.

Revenue sharing & energy sovereignty: Paraguay 90%+ hydro electricity/exports to Brazil/revenue to treasury/industrialization/infra/sovereign wealth fund/energy independence/negotiating chip

expected_zh: 以"双边水电共治+收益分成+含水层跨国管理+能源主权"四位一体，在跨国河流/共享含水层/不对称实力四重约束中实现水资源联邦治理，为跨国水资源共治提供南美范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'binational hydro co-governance + revenue sharing + aquifer transnational management + energy sovereignty' achieves water federal governance amid quadruple constraints of transboundary rivers/shared aquifer/asymmetric power, providing South American paradigm for transnational water co-governance.
